text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, Air Groove-san asked me to do it, so 
I really have no choice, Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Please, do this for my sake. Could you 
just stay quietly in your room, at least 
while the student council is hosting our 
guests?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No waaay, no can dooo. If I'm not 
constantly roaming the seven seas, my 
gills will dry up, and I'll turn into Gold 
Ship jerkyyy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you don't have to head back 
to your room... How about staying here and 
playing some games with me instead?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're completely free to decide what kind 
of game we play, Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hoooh...? Welp then, let's settle this 
with "Goltik Rock-Paper-Scissors"☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... First of all, in honor of the 
seven seas, this game features eight 
'hands'—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Door-in-the-face... a rudimentary 
technique.\nPresenting an easy condition 
like 'hanging out' right after\nan 
unacceptable request like 'staying cooped 
up in the room'—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(As long as I can stall her, victory is 
mine. Heh... Even with the world's most 
whimsical girl, once you control her 
'whims,' it's nothing to worry about—)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so, this is the first "hand"— the pose 
representing the "Goltic Sea"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, like this, right? Now, what is your 
next "move"?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...I got bored in like two seconds making 
Lord Rula do funny poses on a whim, so 
says Golshi. Hang on, let me come up with 
some real rules."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! H-Heheh...! —I'll win...! I'll 
definitely win...!
